cases.refreshed: Join us for an in-person adult English Language Learner (ELL) Conversation Club. Are you looking for a place to practice your English conversation skills in a fun, welcoming and safe environment? Our English Language Learners (ELL) Conversation Club gives adults a respectful setting to practice everyday English conversation. All skill levels are welcome. The presenter is bilingual in both English and Chinese Mandarin. Other English language learners are welcome. Free. No registration required.
